title: Sunny OC rework
description:
Sunny is a mycologist working at the SIOS-1 station laboratory. Her main responsibility is studying specimens from the Zone, but since the higher-ups barely pay any attention to SIOS-1, she spends most of her time working on her own projects and experiments. One of her earliest creations is a creature named Gribobas.

Gribobas is a sentient humanoid mushroom grown by Sunny to help her with experiments and handle heavy lifting around the storage areas. Unfortunately, his mental development never progressed beyond that of a five-year-old child. He understands simple things well enough, but anything more complicated tends to go over his head. He can easily get upset or offended over the smallest things.
